      \draw[eraInk, line width=1.35pt] (-19pt,\eraKeyY) -- (-5pt,\eraKeyY); \draw[eraInk, line width=0.9pt, fill=eraInk] (-12pt,\eraKeyY) circle (1.5pt); \node[era key] {Augmented};
